packageRules.description: The `packageManager` field is an exact version by definition — corepack reads one — so it is skipped as `is-pinned` for the same reason as the image tags below, and keyed on the field rather than on `pnpm` because the reason is the field.

An image tag is a single version by definition, so the repo-wide `updatePinnedDependencies: false` — which exists for the exact-pinned npm deps that owe a dedicated pass — would otherwise skip every one as `is-pinned`. `pinDigests` is what reaches a tag that never moves, where the digest behind it is the only thing left to update. Both are read during the lookup, so this rule carries no `matchUpdateTypes`: an update type exists only once the lookup has produced an update.
A digest bump has no version to read, so it lands on the same branch automerge the minor/patch rule above gives everything else.
